subject: Engineering decisions
title: Rust browser daemon, page-state commands
question: What was measured for Rust browser daemon, page-state commands?
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Reported observations and context: - Added `shell-eval`, `outer-eval`, `opened-urls` (with `at`), `permission` (browser-level `Browser.setPermission`, falling back to the default context), `clipboard`, `set-device` and `keyboard` to the Rust daemon. The five-then-two tests of the new `browser-state` suite passed on the Node daemon first, then on Rust unchanged: 37.1 s then 3.3 s for the first three, 19.7 s then about 1.8 s for the last two (n=1).
